column1: # Every branch of what `sidecar agent report-session --hook-stdin` does with a
# Devin hook payload, including the branches a healthy session never produces.
# The payloads are translated from what Herdr's own devin asset reads: its
# hook_session_id() takes the first non-empty string of ("session_id",
# "sessionId"), its resolve_session_id() returns None when neither is there and
# the list fallback is disallowed, and Sidecar has no list fallback at all, so
# "no session id" always ends in "nothing recorded" rather than in a guess.
# The file is here rather than beside the adapter because the extraction it
# drives is the CLI's: hookPayload and its sessionID() in agent_report_session.go
# are what turn a provider's bytes into a reference, and Devin is the payload
# shape that made the camelCase spelling necessary.
# `outcome` is what the extraction produces:
#   id       the pane binds to the identifier in `want`
#   path     the pane binds to the transcript path in `want`
#   none     no reference; the command records nothing and still exits 0
#   subagent the payload belongs to a nested conversation, so the pane's own
#            binding is left exactly as it was
#   invalid  the payload cannot be decoded at all, and the command refuses
# name
snake-case
camel-case
both-spellings
camel-case-on-a-later-event
empty-snake-falls-through
whitespace-only-id
no-session-at-all
transcript-path-only
sub-agent
non-string-id
